required_current_behaviors: keep task protocol metadata reconciled before material checkpoint/final durable response
end every final active-durable-task response with verified progress commit receipt
use COMMITTED only after owner authority re-read verification
route all Financial business work through the single GitHub-backed owner trajectory

handoff_conformance.business_rule_authority: skills/financial-writing-agent/SKILL.md plus stage-specific references plus continuity/FINANCIAL_OWNER_EXECUTION.json

artifact_io.reason: Financial Writing persists article state, stage/review/publication evidence and delivery identities under one GitHub main workspace and requires fresh-read/CAS/post-write verification.

operational_hygiene.reason: Material writing defects and user corrections must become durable owner evidence, be globally reframed when systemic, and close only after verified maintenance without creating duplicate execution paths.

evolution.reason: Writing-quality changes are promoted only from evidence-backed candidate comparison and regression; one-off edits remain evidence rather than automatic policy.

hook_bindings.durable_task_state_location: main/workspaces/articles/{task_id}/STATE.json with stage/review/publication refs under the same main workspace. continuity/tasks/financial-writing-main is workspace recovery metadata, not per-article business state.
hook_bindings.authoritative_business_evidence_classes: GitHub main article STATE.json plus Git-identity-bound research/editorial/title/draft/review/publication checkpoints and exact current-session delivery/mechanical evidence.
hook_bindings.canonical_artifact_or_file_stores: GitHub main article workspace for durable publication/checkpoint evidence; produced Word artifacts require stable hashes and explicit delivery metadata. Transient chat attachments are delivery surfaces, not checkpoint authority.
hook_bindings.cache_or_reference_only_stores: Chat history, Notion, Google Drive, Library, search/render caches, historical evals and maintenance branches are reference/evidence surfaces and never override current main owner state by presence.
hook_bindings.stable_identity_strategy: task_id + repository path + blob SHA for durable stage/publication artifacts; delivered files use ArtifactKind + sha256; feedback uses task_id + system-impact id + evidence ref.
hook_bindings.read_freshness_requirements: Before every material Financial action reread current main STATE.json and exact required stage refs. Prior-chat summaries, historical branches and deprecated runtime stores never satisfy freshness-sensitive reads.
hook_bindings.mutation_conflict_strategy: Every article mutation binds the freshly fetched STATE.json blob SHA and writes with compare-and-swap. Universal current-writer lease/resume_epoch is an additional outer invariant; blob CAS alone must not be described as lease proof.
hook_bindings.post_write_verification_method: Reread STATE.json and every new referenced artifact after each material write. Tool success or local guard acceptance alone is not COMMITTED proof.
hook_bindings.upstream_to_downstream_invalidation_rule: Any material research/editorial/title/draft change invalidates dependent downstream evidence according to financial_writing_agent/workflow_spec.py; stale delivery manifests are cleared when DELIVERY is downstream.
hook_bindings.delete_and_retention_rules: Retain accepted publication/audit/learning/system-impact evidence and unresolved maintenance obligations. Delete or demote only superseded active mechanisms after dependency checks; Git history remains engineering evidence.
hook_bindings.superseded_artifact_cleanup_rule: Retired OWNER_NATIVE/GITHUB_CHAT-as-adapter/per-article-branch mechanisms must not remain referenced by current Skill, manifest, task handoff, capability profile or execution contract. Historical evals/branches may remain evidence only.
hook_bindings.external_artifact_vault_if_any: No external store is implicitly authoritative. Another provider becomes an artifact vault only with stable refs and verified write/readback receipts, and never becomes a second task-state authority.
hook_bindings.observability_or_incident_evidence_locat: main article workspace learning/system-impact evidence plus evals/system audits and Universal control signals for systemic defects.
hook_bindings.self_maintenance_trigger_path: Material user correction or assistant-detected systemic defect -> durable Financial evidence -> current Universal signal plane when shared control-plane repair is required.
hook_bindings.garbage_collection_owner_and_dependency_: references/maintenance.md controls contradictory/legacy mechanism cleanup; historical evidence may be retained but no superseded mechanism may remain on the current execution path.
hook_bindings.reliability_or_change_freeze_guard: A failing Financial capability freezes only the affected stage/reliability boundary. It does not activate a deprecated fallback route and does not freeze unrelated healthy owners.
hook_bindings.learning_evidence_location: Exact main article workspace learning evidence and system-impact items; evidence is not automatic rule promotion.
hook_bindings.superseded_mechanism_cleanup_rule: Prefer consolidation/deletion/quarantine of superseded mechanisms; current authority files and tests must fail if retired dual-route semantics re-enter the hot path.

overrides.evaluator_selection: owner-local blind pairwise quality evaluation with candidate-position swap and evidence binding
overrides.artifact_locations: GitHub main article workspaces are the sole durable Financial business-state authority

remaining_unproven_boundaries: non-forgeable lease/resume_epoch fencing on every Financial mutation

retired_state_authorities: SQLite WritingState for new/resumed Financial work
legacy_quarantine.legacy_state_token: GITHUB_CHAT is tolerated only inside schema-1.2 article state/receipt compatibility surfaces and must not appear as a current route selector or component path
